title: Comparison of automated and manual mRNA enrichment to automated rRNA depletion for whole-blood RNA-sequencing
description: RNA sequencing libraries were prepared from PAXgene whole blood RNA collected from 28 participants, including 21 people living with HIV (PLWH) and 7 HIV-negative controls. Three library preparation protocols were compared to assess their impact on downstream bioinformatic analyses: (1) automated poly(A) mRNA enrichment (autoE), (2) manual poly(A) mRNA enrichment (manE), and (3) automated ribosomal RNA (rRNA) depletion (autoD). Sequencing was performed on the MGI DNBSEQ-G400RS platform, and RT-qPCR data from unprocessed RNA served as an orthogonal comparator.
